The inequalities -1/4<=X<=2 and positivity 1+2X>=1/2 give both global extrema and equality phases, without relying on the finite 216-triple census. Uniqueness of the 3-phase gauge yields two normalized minimizers and one maximizer; q-phase counts 2q^3 iff 6|q and q^3 for maxima. Supports of Q^3 lie in [-3,3]^2, hence sampling grids m,n>=7 do not alias.
